overview.description: The high-speed centrifuge is the single most important piece of equipment for the miniprep. Balance is everything - an unbalanced rotor is dangerous and ruins runs.

steps.description: The high-speed centrifuge is the single most important piece of equipment for the miniprep. Balance is everything - an unbalanced rotor is dangerous and ruins runs.
steps.intro: The high-speed centrifuge is the single most important piece of equipment for the miniprep. Balance is everything - an unbalanced rotor is dangerous and ruins runs.

instructions.title: Always balance
instructions.description: Place tubes symmetrically; add a water-filled balance tube if you have an odd number.

instructions.title: Choose the speed
instructions.description: Convert between rpm and relative centrifugal force (g) for your rotor; use g in protocols.

instructions.title: Pellet & decant
instructions.description: Spin to pellet cells/debris, then carefully decant or pipette off the supernatant.

submission.description: Describe a balanced loading scheme for an odd number of samples and the g-force you'd use to pellet E. coli.

kits.name: Mini benchtop centrifuge
kits.note: 6-8 tube mini-fuge for minipreps and spins; balance your tubes.
